question: Which room inputs matter to the fitted predictor?
takeaway: The fitted E3 model selected a constant dummy baseline; it has no spatial feature attribution to estimate. Publishing nonzero importance would invent a learned effect.
method: Exploratory model-specific feature importance would be shown only beside grouped performance and only for a nonconstant fitted model.
caveats: A constant baseline has no feature-level explanation.
No causal feature effect can be read from small grouped predictive comparisons.
